preDeployCommand: bun -e 'import { Client } from "pg"; const client = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl: process.env.DATABASE_SSL === "disable" ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: process.env.DATABASE_SSL === "verify-full" } }); await client.connect(); const before = await client.query("select count(*)::int as count from information_schema.tables where table_schema = $$public$$"); await client.query("DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"); const after = await client.query("select count(*)::int as count from information_schema.tables where table_schema = $$public$$"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ publicTablesBefore: before.rows[0].count, publicTablesAfter: after.rows[0].count })); await client.end(); if (after.rows[0].count !== 0) process.exit(1)' && bun --cwd apps/api migrate
